This is the **"Create New World"** screen from Minecraft (likely a modded version or specific edition given the custom difficulty text).

**Visible elements and approximate Y positions (in a 960×540 image):**

*   **Title:** "CREATE NEW WORLD" — **Y: ~35-75**
*   **Seed info text** (SEED: NUMBER = ITSELF...) — **Y: ~105-125**
*   **NAME label & input field** ("New World") — **Y: ~145-245**
*   **SEED label & input field** ("1180916...") — **Y: ~255-355**
*   **GAME MODE: SURVIVAL button** — **Y: ~385-450**
*   **WORLD TYPE: NORMAL button** — **Y: ~470-535**
*   **CREATE WORLD text** (DEPLETING STACKS. REAL DAMAGE. RESPAWN) — **Y: ~650-685**
*   **CANCEL button** — **Y: ~745-810**

*Note: The Y coordinates assume standard UI scaling where the main buttons are centered vertically, with the additional modded difficulty description and cancel button positioned below the typical viewport center.*
